## Description
This dataset contains subscription and demographic information for 300 unique customers. It tracks key metrics including service plan tiers, geographic regions, monthly expenditures, and the age of each account in days. The data provides a snapshot of customer segmentation and spending behavior across different service levels and locations.

## Notable Characteristics
* **Completeness:** The dataset is fully populated with no null values across any of the fields.
* **Uniqueness:** Every record is uniquely identified by a `customer_id`, ensuring a one-to-one relationship between the identifier and the customer profile.
* **Balanced Categorical Distribution:** The dataset features a perfectly balanced distribution across geographic regions, with each of the four regions containing exactly 75 records.
* **Variable Spending and Tenure:** Monthly spending and account age exhibit significant variability, ranging from minimal starting values to substantial maximums (up to $263.74 and 1,210 days, respectively).
* **Plan Distribution:** The subscription tiers are distributed among the customer base with 50% on the Basic plan, 33.3% on the Plus plan, and 16.7% on the Pro plan.
